source_text: Septem tribus absque sorte. Iesus: Usquequo estis tepidi? Mittite viros ut describant terram. Desidia increpata.
pass_a_gloss: Seven tribes without lot. Jesus: How-long are-you lukewarm? Send men that they-may-describe land. Sloth rebuked.
pass_b_english: [[Seven tribes still without portion >> Bible:Joshua 18:2]]. Jesus: [[How long will you be slack? Send men to map the land >> Bible:Joshua 18:3-4]]. Sloth is rebuked.
